in_sanskrit.name: Laboni
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Jasmine, Lotus
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Laboni एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Laboni is derived from the Sanskrit words 'Labh' (to obtain) and 'Ni' (joy). It is a beautiful name that signifies the joy of attainment. The name is also associated with jasmine and lotus, symbols of beauty, grace, and purity.
